name: TARSELE Extendable table, oak veneer/black, 59/78 3/4x31 1/2 "

dimensions.source: IKEA Measurements section, read in Chrome 2026-10-26 (Length closed -> w, Width -> d, Height -> h; open 78 3/4")

notes: An alternative for Andrew's larger dining table (2026-10-26): dining-room g. Flags: none closed, tight:33.25 open (F-36). Fit: along the room's depth, closed 59" it leaves 30" to the bottom wall for a seat at the end and 33.25" on each long side (x 63.25-94.75); open to 78 3/4" it stands like the LISABO, its end 10 1/4" from the bottom wall. Oak veneer top (fiberboard with oak veneer) on black legs: the top the tone of the honey-oak floor and the maple kitchen, the legs the sofa's dark note; the leaf stores inside. Three packages (33 x 33 x 4 3/4" at 67 lb 4 oz, 33 x 29 1/4 x 5 1/4" at 24 lb 15 oz, 62 x 5 x 3" at 16 lb 16 oz). Not stocked at IKEA Long Island, NY; order online for delivery (2026-10-26). 4.6 stars (146). Twice the LISABO's price for the table alone.
